title.zh: 先搞清楚模型一定会错在哪
title.en: First, Understand Exactly Where the Model Will Always Fail

subtitle.zh: AI-FDE转型之路·AI工程01-LLM能力与边界
subtitle.en: The AI-FDE Transition Path · AI Engineering 01 — LLM Capabilities & Boundaries

summary.zh: 做 AI 交付，第一件事不是学怎么调模型，而是知道它能做什么、不能做什么、会在哪儿错。这篇给出四类必错场景，以及「什么算会了」。
summary.en: In AI delivery, the first thing to learn is not how to tune a model, but what it can and cannot do and where it always fails. This piece lays out four failure classes and what 'knowing it' looks like.
